patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Printful and Spocket share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Printful and Spocket share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Printful only if your buying job matches “Print-on-demand fulfillment — Free $0; Growth $24.99/mo (waived after $12k/year sales) wit” rather than Spocket's shape. Choose Spocket only if your buying job matches “US/EU dropshipping sourcing app — Starter $39.99/mo, Pro $59.99/mo, Empire $99.99/mo, Unic” rather than Printful's shape. Workflow advantage: Printful leans online-storefront; Spocket leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Printful and Spocket share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Printful is Print-on-demand fulfillment — Free $0; Growth $24.99/mo (waived after $12k/year sales) with 14-day trial; Enterprise quote. Product print co; Spocket is US/EU dropshipping sourcing app — Starter $39.99/mo, Pro $59.99/mo, Empire $99.99/mo, Unicorn $299.99/mo; 7-day trial; product caps per tier.
- Workflow coverage skew: Printful-leaning online-storefront vs Spocket-leaning —.
- Researched limits: Printful — Not a checkout platform — Shopify/Woo/Etsy/etc. (or Printful Stores add-on) required; Spocket — Not a storefront — requires Shopify, WooCommerce, Wix, BigCommerce, or similar.

Limitations — Printful: Not a checkout platform — Shopify/Woo/Etsy/etc. (or Printful Stores add-on) required; Product print and shipping costs are separate from the $0–$24.99 subscription; Spocket: Not a storefront — requires Shopify, WooCommerce, Wix, BigCommerce, or similar; Product caps force tier upgrades as catalog grows.

Poor-fit cases: Printful is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a checkout platform — Shopify/Woo/Etsy/etc. (or Printful Stores add-on) required · Spocket is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a storefront — requires Shopify, WooCommerce, Wix, BigCommerce, or similar · Avoid Printful if you actually need Spocket's motion (US/EU dropshipping sourcing app — Starter $39.99/mo, Pro $59.99/mo, Empire $99.9)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
